events.title: Irmo, SC, US - Nov 29th - Soda City Disc Dogs

details.title: Irmo, SC, US – Nov 29th – Soda City Disc Dogs
details.event_address: Irmo YMCA, 1501 Kennerly Rd, Irmo, SC 29063, United States
details.additional_event_information_for_partici:
IT’S-A-ME, UPDOG!
Get ready to grab your discs and power up! We’re hosting a Mario-themed UpDog competition at the Irmo YMCA 1501 Kennerly Rd, Irmo SC 29063 on November 29th!
We’ll get started at 9:30 AM and will be offering Level 1 games only, making this a great opportunity for newer teams to come out, play, and have some fun. Our Far Out field will be set at 100 yards, so bring your best throws and let those discs fly!
Game Order:
Throw N Go
4 Way Play
Greedy
Spaced Out
Boom
Time Warp
Far Out
⭐️ Fun Awards & Photo Ops
We’ll have some fun Mario-themed awards throughout the day, along with plenty of opportunities to grab some fun photos with your dogs!
Photography
Shannon Moseby will be photographing the event.
Judging
Head Judge: Alexandra Nolte
Secondary Judge: Emily Allred
️ Workers Raffle
Want to help make the day run smoothly? We’ll be doing a Workers Raffle for anyone willing to lend a hand with line judging or running announcements/timer throughout the event. Help out, earn raffle entries, and have a chance to win some fun prizes!
FEO — Exhibition Only
Not quite ready to put your scores on the board? No problem! FEO is a great way to try out the games in a low-pressure, no-score-submission format.
There is a separate sign-up box for FEO rounds, so if you’re planning to run FEO, make sure you register there.
New to UpDog? No problem!
This is a beginner-friendly event, and I’d love to have you join us!
Let’s-a-go!

details.additional_event_information_for_partici:
Come join us for a Muppet Christmas Carol themed UpDog competition at the Irmo YMCA on November 29th!
We’ll start at 9:30 AM and will be offering Level 1 games only, making this a great event for newer teams to come out, play, and have some fun. Our Far Out field will be set at 100 yards, so bring your best throws!
Freestyle
We’re especially excited to offer Freestyle at this event! Teams will get one performance round to show off their creativity, teamwork, and holiday spirit. Start thinking about your music, costumes, and choreography because we want to see what you’ve got!
Game Order
Throw N Go
Freestyle (Perfomance Round)
Funkey
7 Up
Frizgility
Greedy
Far Out
We’ll have Muppet Christmas Carol themed awards, along with some fun Christmas photo opportunities for you and your dogs. Whether you’re feeling more like Kermit, Miss Piggy, Fozzie, Gonzo, Rizzo, or even a little Scrooge, come ready to have some fun with the theme.
Ugly Sweater Contest
What’s Christmas without an ugly sweater? Come dressed in your best, worst, most ridiculous Christmas sweater for our Ugly Sweater Contest! We’ll have a special prize for the winner, so don’t be afraid to get creative.
Photography
Shannon Moseby will be photographing the event, so you’ll have the chance to get some great action shots and Christmas memories with your dogs.
Judging
Head Judge: Alexandra Nolte
Secondary Judge: Emily Allred
Workers Raffle
Every good production needs a crew behind the scenes! If you’re willing to help with line judging or running announcements/timer, we’ll have a Workers Raffle for our volunteers. Help keep the day running smoothly and earn a chance at some fun prizes.
FEO
There will be no FEO at this event.
New to UpDog?
This is a beginner-friendly event, and I’d love to have you join me!
Come spend the day playing some UpDog, celebrating the holidays, and getting into the spirit of An Uppy Christmas Carol.
“Light the lamp, not the rat!”

details.additional_event_information_for_partici:
LAST CHANCE UPDOG
Need a few more UpDog points before the year wraps up? Come join us on December 20th for a no-frills UpDog event focused on getting those last-minute points!
No theme, no extras, just dogs, discs, and lots of opportunities to play.
We’ll be offering two rounds of each game, giving you plenty of chances to get out there and finish the year strong.
Games Offered-
Throw N Go
4 Way Play
Spaced Out
Time Warp
7 Up
Frizgility
Funkey
Greedy
Boom
Far Out
Mulligans
We’ll be offering Mulligans at this event for $10 per team/dog. Mulligan profits will be donated to Planned Parenthood Columbia.
Here’s how it works:
At registration, you can purchase one Mulligan ticket for $10 per team/dog.
Having a bad round? Before time expires, loudly yell “MULLIGAN!”
Turn in your Mulligan ticket and immediately restart the round from scratch.
Your original score is completely wiped out and does not count.
Your new round becomes your official and unchangeable score, even if the second attempt ends up being worse than the first.
Mulligans are limited to one round per event per team.
Important Reminder
Dogs are only eligible to compete in 10 rounds per day, regardless of handler. Please keep this in mind when planning your runs.
Two Fields
If we exceed 100 total runs, we will run two fields to help keep the day moving and get everyone through their rounds efficiently.
Whether you’re chasing a few more points, trying to squeeze in some extra games before the end of the year, or just want to get out and play, this one is for you.
Come get those last-minute UpDog points and finish out the year with us!
